title: christmas tree shaped light setup
text: christmas tree shaped light setup. Purchased this a little while ago and hubby was setting up.  It's cheap, so we didn't expect much.  I hope it makes it through the season, but I won't hold my breath.  The remote that came with it is total junk.  It doesn't even even match the instructions (see pic) Only a few of the buttons work - the on, off and timer hours.  The 1-11 do not work.  The dimmer doesn't work either.  Super disappointing for sure as I had hoped to change and choose the settings.  At this price point I guess it's too much to ask that they send the right instructions and the right remote I guess.  Eh.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. product_metadata.title: WATERGLIDE Christmas Tree Lights with Star Topper, 300LED with 11 Lighting Mode, 6.6ft x 12 String Lights Warm White & Multicolor with Remote for Christmas Decorations, Indoor/Outdoor Xmas Tree Decor
features: Christmas Tree Lights: 300 LED Warm White & Multicolor color changing lights for Christmas Tree add a different vibe. Crown your Christmas tree with this impressive string lights with golden star tree topper. Warm white and Multicolor will alternate in the 11 lighting mode. When in these lighting modes, colors will be displayed fix sequence. No specific colors can be set. The Christmas Lights have 12 strand drops, each 6.6ft long and fit 6-7.5ft Christmas tree.

Humanized Design: Our tree decoration lights comes with a 10 inch topper star and 12 strands LED string lights which is 6.6 feet long, each strand has 25 LEDs, and the extension cord is 16.5ft. No need to winding many lights around and through all the branches of a tree. The tree topper can be disassembled according to your requirement.

11 Lighting Mode & Timer: Just point the remote at the controller of the lights. 11 lighting modes - combination, warm white steady on, multicolor steady on, mixed color 1, mixed color 2, mixed color fading, mixed color jump, warm white twinkle, multicolor twinkle, warm white / multicolor fading, in wave. And built in timer function - 2H: 2 hours ON, 22 hours OFF; 4H: 4 hours ON, 20 hours OFF; 6H: 6 hours ON, 18 hours OFF; 8H: 8 hours ON, 16 hours OFF.

Safety & Easy to Install: These indoor/outdoor icicle Christmas tree lights have 20V low output by plug-in and are certificated for safe use of UL. Just put the black plastic rings on top of the Tree, install the tree topper, and drooping the light cords. You'll have a better way to decorate a tree that not only looks better than the others, but is also much easier to do.

Great Gift for Christmas: WATERPROOF(IP44) Perfect for indoor and outdoor tree decorations. Package in a beautiful box, which is very suitable as a Christmas gift for your lover, friends, and colleagues.
